text:
Alex Kim: Heads up — proposal to operatorize the tenant connector. Goal: move control-plane handshake logic out of the bootstrap lambda and into a k8s operator running in customer VPCs. Thoughts?

Maria Chen: +1 for observability and life-cycle hooks. Operator can own cert rotation, metrics, CR status.

Jordan SRE: Concern: running operator per-tenant increases explosion of controllers. How do we limit resource footprint?

Anika Patel: We could implement a lightweight operator pattern: single binary watching a CRD but deployed per-region as DaemonSet or per-tenant as deployment? Prefer per-tenant as deployment with strict resource limits.

Sam Ortiz: Alternative: keep bootstrap lambda for short-lived bootstrap, but operator takes over post-onboard. Cutover window seems doable.

Alex Kim: Main tradeoffs: peering credentials handling, control-plane tokens, NAT-preservation for egress. Operator needs to support two modes: peering-managed and privatelink.

Maria Chen: Implementation sketch:
```
apiVersion: infra.redwood/v1
kind: TenantConnector
metadata:
  name: tenant-1234
spec:
  mode: peering | privatelink
  cpEndpoint: cp.redwood-region.internal
  egressPreserveSrcIP: true
```
Status fields for handshake progress.

Jordan SRE: Rollout: start with opt-in beta for low-traffic tenants. Add circuit-breaker to auto-fallback to bootstrap lambda if operator fails.

Anika Patel: Ops concerns: upgrades and schema migration. Need CRD versioning and migration path.

Sam Ortiz: Also think about RBAC — operator will need cross-account IAM role handling. Suggest flow: operator creates assume-role pods using IRSA for AWS.

Alex Kim: Next steps: spike to implement CRD and operator scaffold, test with synthetic tenant, timeline 2 sprints. Who wants to OWN spike?

Maria Chen: I'll take OWNER for spike. Will pair with Jordan for SLOs.

Jordan SRE: I'll help. I'll add a checklist in the RFC doc link: <https://redwood.internal/docs/connector-operator-spike>. ops-bot: create task.

ops-bot: Created task #9876 assigned to Maria Chen, Jordan SRE.

Alex Kim: Thanks. Let's sync Thurs 11am. :calendar:
